account.name: 叙事局
account.promise: 把复杂的故事，讲成看得见的选择。

usage.avatar: Use narrative-mark.svg only; do not put long Chinese text in small avatars.
usage.youtube_bilibili: Use the same master mark and adapt banner crop, not identity.
usage.cover: Master logo stays small; series label and episode hook carry the click decision.
usage.first_frame: Use story hook first; watermark may enter after the first beat.
usage.watermark: Bottom-right, low opacity, never over captions or evidence labels.
